fields.label: Game log folder
fields.help: The Star Citizen channel folder that holds Game.log, such as the LIVE folder of the install. Blank finds it automatically. Changing it rebuilds the ledger from the logs.

fields.label: Wipe date
fields.help: yyyy-MM-dd. Everything logged before it is ignored. Blank reads the whole history. Changing it rebuilds the ledger from the logs.

fields.label: Open window at startup
fields.help: Shows the Item Tracker window when OCRX starts the plugin. Its icon in the notification area opens it at any time. Takes effect at the next start.

fields.label: Window theme
fields.help: Light or dark colours for the Item Tracker window. Follow Windows matches the app mode chosen in Windows settings and changes with it. Takes effect at once.
